prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, channels and company size. To help you pick one I can either give a tailored shortlist or walk you through how to evaluate agencies. Quick guidance and next steps:

Questions (answer any that apply)
- What’s your primary goal? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce growth, shopper marketing, PR, etc.)
- Industry or audience?
- Monthly or project budget range?
- Do you prefer a local boutique or a large/global network?
- Timeline and important deliverables (campaign start date, KPI targets)?
- Any existing in‑house marketing capabilities?

How to evaluate agencies (brief)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just awards)
- Client references and contract terms (scope, reporting cadence)
- Team makeup and senior involvement
- Expertise in the channels you need (SEO, paid media, creative, CRM, shopper)
- Cultural fit and communication style

Local agencies you might consider (examples, by strength)
- Barkley — KC‑based creative agency known for big integrated brand campaigns and bold creative work.
- VML / VMLY&R — global digital and experience agency with strong strategy + tech capability (good for larger brands and omnichannel work).
- The Integer Group — strong in shopper and retail marketing (good if your focus is shopping/retail activation).

If you’d like, tell me your answers to the questions above and I’ll prepare a short list of 4–6 Kansas City agencies matched to your needs, with notes on strengths, typical budgets and suggested next questions to ask them. Which would you prefer?
